core_requests: Key env aliases: add V3LUM_ABUSECH_KEY and V3LUM_ABUSECH_AUTH_KEY to key 'abusech' (core-owned v3lum/data/providers/abusech.json), V3LUM_MISP_KEY to 'misp' (internal_misp.json) and V3LUM_OPENCTI_TOKEN to 'opencti' (internal_opencti.json): the P175/P348 specs name them; provider-ext fragments cannot add keys.

Core setting thehive_url (https-validated like misp_url/opencti_url, env V3LUM_THEHIVE_URL): until it exists thehive_sightings carries the module setting thehive_sightings_url and internal_thehive.hosts_from_settings points at it (batch p1-G07-2 switches both once the core setting lands).

Finding.tlp (P348 FC6): a per-finding marking (higher of platform and case TLP) and renderers that omit findings above the report TLP; the TIP adapters put the hit marking in finding.data['tlp'] and call res.set_marking(); v3lum.modules.cti_framework.internal_tip_sightings.finding_tlp / visible_in_report implement the rule.

Covert exercises (P348 FC8): ScanOptions.covert (alias no_internal) + CLI --covert/--no-internal recorded in the case; the policy gate should skip every disclosure 'internal' module for such cases (the adapters already return SKIPPED policy when getattr(ctx.options, 'covert'|'no_internal') is true).

Report (P348 FC9, A12): renderers list findings tagged internal_sighting first and print the header line from internal_tip_sightings.internal_sightings_line(hits_by_platform, report_tlp) (order case DB -> MISP/OpenCTI -> TheHive, TLP-filtered).

Scoring/consensus (P173 FC3): the P171 consensus pack / P302 scoring dampens AV-consensus votes on hash nodes whose attribute known_good is True (set by circl_hashlookup) and never touches specific listings; the conflict line ships as rule hashlookup_known_file_conflict.

Detection (P267 FC3): app.resolve_inputs/core.detect should use v3lum.modules.file_analysis.file_hashing.identify_hash + hash_readings(interactive=True) so a TTY lets the analyst choose between SHA-256 and certificate fingerprint for a bare 64-hex value, and pass the explicit choice to the run (e.g. a per-seed explicit-type flag) so file_hashing does not add the other reading; today the CLI never prompts (confidence 0.95) and file_hashing tries both readings for seeds.
Packaging (WP29): add ppdeep>=20200505 to the 'full' extra (v3lum/data/extras/ppdeep.json) and install extras in CI so the real ssdeep reference-vector test runs.

Doctor v2 (P337/WP25) and scan start: run the internal adapters' health_check self-tests (key permission check) and print their write-permission warnings (P348 FC3 'startup check'); the adapters also check on first use, at most once a day per instance.

Alias index (P295/WP17): when the core alias API is published, yaraify.alias_index() should call it instead of reading v3lum/data/aliases/*.json directly; MODULE_GUIDE section 25 name v3lum.core.ioc.extract (WP17) would replace v3lum.core.detect.extract_iocs in circl_hashlookup's pasted-list path.
notes: All four proposals delivered as six modules: circl_hashlookup (P173), yaraify (P175), file_hashing (P267) and the three read-only internal TIP adapters misp_sightings, opencti_sightings, thehive_sightings (P348; TheHive is the P2 adapter of A12 and lands because synthetic TheHive 6.0 fixtures exist). P348 modules live in v3lum/modules/cti_framework/ with category cti_framework as FC1 names them (the proposal row says threat_intel_ioc). circl_hashlookup also accepts text_blob seeds so pasted lists use POST /bulk/md5|sha1 (chunks of 100, 200 per hash type, triage: known-good files listed with expand=False); SHA-512 has no hashlookup/YARAify endpoint (SKIPPED not_applicable). Hash expansion expands only stronger forms (md5 -> sha1/sha256, sha1 -> sha256) to avoid re-querying the same file. YARAify sends the Auth-Key on every call and never calls without it; the YARA 'family_hint' key avoids the sanitizer's 'token' secret heuristic. file_hashing refuses non-regular files before opening and re-checks with fstat after a non-blocking open; the alternate reading pivot of an ambiguous seed uses confidence 0.5 (the engine's min_expand_confidence) so it is tried. TIP adapters: 5 s per lookup, 0.5 s min interval, no cache, value only in JSON/GraphQL bodies, per-platform read-only allow-lists, first-use daily key-permission check (ctx.state) + health_check self-test. New provider internal_thehive (internal, settings host). Vocabulary aligned with batch p1-G07-1 (identical re-declarations). P327 lint (WP09) clean on every file; v3lum/data/lint/p1_g07_2.json adds ntlm.pw to the cracking hosts (FC3 exclusion). Synthetic fixtures: all TIP fixtures, circl conflict_nsrl_record.json (no real LOLDrivers hash found in NSRL), yaraify illegal_search_term.json and the derived 401 exchange. Full offline suite: failures only in other batches' modules and core tests mid-edit (quota, links, datasets, engine status mapping, context); every test of this batch and the registry contract for its six modules pass. No LIGHT/ACTIVE variant was requested.
